prompt: Create an original 180 second lo-fi instrumental hip hop instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: Rhodes piano, muted drums, warm bass. Style: laid-back swung beat and hazy jazz harmony. Tempo approximately 68 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by warm synth pads, gentle strings, and light, unobtrusive percussion. The overall mood is peaceful and slightly melancholic.
description.zh: 一首平静而沉思的器乐作品，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，辅以温暖的合成器音垫、柔和的弦乐和轻柔、不显眼的打击乐。整体氛围宁静而略带忧郁。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
